summary: Rent the Runway filed an Item 8.01 8-K noting that its previously announced $15,000,000 rights offering expired at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 14, 2026. Un exercised rights lapsed and are no longer exercisable. The filing confirms the subscription period close but discloses no pricing, subscription level, standby purchasers, advisor, or board recommendation. As the registrant and issuer of the rights, the company is the filing party. What to watch: the take-up rate and any backstop or remainder financing, since weak participation could signal balance-sheet pressure on the Nasdaq-listed retailer.
